figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the chapter is one negotiation: the drop term versus the Coulomb tax
figures.read: every result is a difference of binding energies, an exponential, or a momentum share

figures.title: The binding-energy curve: everything climbs toward iron
figures.why: the curve is the chapter's decision-maker: moving nucleons up it releases energy
figures.data: B/A vs A: H-2 1.1, He-4 7.1, Fe-56 8.8, U-238 7.6 MeV/nucleon
figures.read: fusion climbs the left slope and fission the right, both toward iron

figures.title: The mass defect is the binding energy
figures.why: half of nuclear problems are mass-defect arithmetic in disguise
figures.data: B = (Z mp + N mn - m_nucleus) c²
figures.read: the nucleus is lighter than its parts; the missing mass is the dismantling energy

figures.title: Exponential decay and its log-linear twin
figures.why: the same law is a halving staircase in N and a straight line in ln N
figures.data: N = N0 e^(-λt): after 1/2/3/4 half-lives the fraction is 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16
figures.read: each half-life halves what remains; the log-linear slope is -λ

figures.title: The carbon-dating clock and its limits
figures.why: the same half-life that makes dating work also caps its range
figures.data: t = (T½/ln2) ln(A0/A), T½ = 5730 y, range a few hundred to ~50 ka
figures.read: the clock runs from the moment exchange stops; tree rings correct the ratio

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: masses to Q-values, time to half-life, chains name their equilibrium first
